column3: requireInvitationGrantScopesValid (#3554 review follow-up 2) is an early refusal only: it keeps an invitation whose grant the role-scope check would refuse from creating an account and spending the link. It is not load-bearing: every grant applyInvitationGrants then writes re-runs requireScopeValidForRole at its own write, so a role scope changed between the two is decided there (refused: the account is reverted and the invitation stays pending, as before). A scope change never touches existing grants, so either order equals a serial one.
